PaymentInstrument.name: PaymentInstrument
PaymentInstrument.description: Represents a payment method or financial instrument used for transactions. Contains details such as card information, bank account data, payment processor references, and disbursement address information for processing payments and outbound disbursements.

AccountHolderName.description: Name of the payment instrument holder.

AccountId.description: The ID of the Account or PersonAccount that is using the payment instrument.

BankAccountHolderType.description: Determines if the bank account holder is an individual or a company.

BankAccountNumber.description: The bank account number used for payment.

BankCode.description: Code of bank associated with the bank account.

BankName.description: Name of bank associated with the bank account.

CardBrand.description: The credit card brand, network, or issuer.

DigitalWalletProvider.description: The provider of the digital wallet.

DisbursementAddress.description: This is a compound field of type Address and combines these fields: DisbursementCity, DisbursementCountry, DisbursementGeocodeAccuracy, DisbursementLatitude, DisbursementLongitude, DisbursementPostalCode, DisbursementState, and DisbursementStreet. For more information, see Address Compound Fields.

ExpiryMonth.description: Expire month if payment method is credit card.

ExpiryYear.description: Expire year if payment method is credit card.

ExternalPayeeIdentifier.description: External identifier for the payee in external payment systems.

GatewayName.description: The name of the payment gateway.

GatewayReference.description: A reference number from the gateway for this payment instrument.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The name of the Payment Instrument.

OwnerId.description: ID of the owner of this record.

PaymentProcessorName.description: The name of the payment processor.

ProcessorReference.description: The reference of the payment processor associated with the payment instrument.

Status.description: The status of the payment instrument.

Type.description: Specifies the type of the payment instrument.

PaymentInstrument.accessRules: This object is available only if Outbound Payments is enabled in your org, and you have access to Outbound Payments entities.
